title: ÆTHER: First Love v18 (Tamil pop with a rap verse, lyrics by Mr. Kavi)
story: A boy sees a girl for the first time and falls in love, as a bright modern Tamil pop song: hummed hook, a catchy Tanglish chorus, a playful rap verse from the boy, and the chorus at its fullest.

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 10:57 on v17 (Tamil): the lyrics sound too old-fashioned; give it a pop touch, pop or rap. v18 = modern Tamil pop with English words mixed in (Tanglish), a short male rap verse, his loved humming in the intro and outro, the same G major and 92 BPM; romanised lines (Tanglish is written in English letters). Lyric sheet /mnt/project-files/music/first-love-v18/first-love-v18-lyrics.md.
